Class NetworkParser.Connection

java.lang.Object
NetworkParser.Connection
Enclosing class:
NetworkParser
public static class NetworkParser.Connection extends Object
Data class representing a connection between two edges at a junction. Connections define which lanes can transition from one edge to another, and which traffic lights control those transitions.
